description: What the Android reader's runtime is built with beside the pins (proof/pins.json), each named exactly, so one build of the runtime is every build of it. build-runtime.sh fetches Gradle's distribution and Robolectric's Android runtime by these checksums, refuses an Android SDK package at another revision, and holds every dependency Gradle resolves to verification-metadata.xml where that file is beside this one. The stage's workflow installs this JDK and these SDK packages (.github/workflows/proof-android.yml). The reader's fingerprint names this file (proof/android/records.py), so a change here reads every archive again.
